title: Integral Control and Root-Locus Design for DC Motor Torque Tracking
expert_review: Good example highlighting torque control and the need for integral action in classical control design.
learning_objectives: Derive torque transfer functions of DC motors
Understand the role of zeros in control design
Explain why integral action is required for constant tracking
Apply root-locus techniques to torque control problems
Assess stability of feedback systems using pole locations
